protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. In setuid enforcement of LimitContainerPaths, AuthorizedPath cleans and resolves each configured path but then applies strings.HasPrefix to the complete resolved image path. A sibling such as /data/safe-but-unsafe therefore matches /data/safe; filepath.Clean also removes a defensive trailing slash.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed as 48b4735d5a8d152af30123d6621b123ca87f9864. git log -L shows this commit changed dirname from filepath.Dir(i.Path) to i.Path and exact equality to strings.HasPrefix; earlier 8ac2f4a613a30a3b7d4be55b2b1ab49fcd95ff00 introduced only the non-vulnerable exact-directory helper.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. The sole parent c91ef4f8027e2b3d63656e1364709f23d8877932 uses filepath.Dir(i.Path) and dirname == match, has no strings import, and already routes LimitContainerPaths through AuthorizedPath.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed not applicable. The BIC is a single-parent public commit and git line history exposes the exact atomic transition; no finer public member is represented in the clone. Later 8d47ee667fca6bae3d5d7bde4806f8f502a8cbf3 is a 100% file rename, and 608fcea15cbb6079dae7bd2865f2b865a03af738 only adds initFile while preserving HasPrefix.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: Confirmed. The BIC is absent from v3.0.0-alpha.1, present from v3.0.0-alpha.2 through v3.1.1, and present in v4.4.0 and v4.4.1. v4.4.1 still contains the vulnerable HasPrefix implementation.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: Confirmed. c08791793e843d4c9c1f2fc1d9d12abef747378f is not in v4.4.1 and is in v4.4.2; v4.4.2 contains the filepath.Rel plus filepath.IsLocal implementation. The vendor changelog names CVE-2026-47215 and GHSA-wqcr-7rf3-f64m.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix c08791793e843d4c9c1f2fc1d9d12abef747378f. Its patch removes strings.HasPrefix at AuthorizedPath, compares the image path relative to the allowed root, and adds a regression where xxx/foobar must not match xxx/foo.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: Confirmed NOT_AI on the BIC only. The BIC commit object names Cedric Clerget as both author and committer, has one parent and a GPG signature, has empty trailers, and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Copilot, ChatGPT, or bot marker. Later fix metadata was not used for attribution.
protocol_checks.advisory_disposition: Confirmed real and not withdrawn. The live GitHub advisory is reviewed with withdrawn_at null and points to the direct fix; CVE.org currently returns CVE_RECORD_DNE, while the vendor v4.4.2 changelog explicitly ships the CVE/GHSA and the vulnerable and fixed tag contents reproduce the reported mechanism. This is not FALSE_POSITIVE.
